# Evergreen Veterinary Clinic

> > Full-service veterinary clinic in San Jose, CA providing comprehensive pet care, surgery, and preventive medicine with a team of experienced veterinarians and certified technicians.

Evergreen Veterinary Clinic (EVC) is an American Animal Hospital Association accredited practice serving the San Jose and greater Bay Area community. The clinic features UC Davis-trained veterinarians, registered veterinary technicians (RVTs), and specializes in wellness care, surgery, dermatology, and nutrition with multilingual staff supporting English, Spanish, and Greek-speaking clients.

## Key Topics

- Veterinary Services

## Veterinary Services

- [Wellness & Preventive Care](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/services/wellness-preventive-care): Wellness exams, vaccinations, and preventive care services
- [Soft Tissue Surgery](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/services/soft-tissue-surgery): Surgical services including hernia repair and mass removal procedures
- [Allergies](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/services/allergies): Pet allergy testing, dermatology, food allergies, and skin conditions
- [Diet & Nutrition](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/services/diet-nutrition): Pet nutrition, weight management, supplements, and life-stage feeding

## Pet Health Resources

- [Flea and Tick Prevention](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/blog/flea-and-tick-prevention): Guide to flea and tick prevention, parasites, and pet care medication
- [Why is My Cat Overgrooming Itself?](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/blog/why-is-my-cat-overgrooming-itself): Cat overgrooming causes: allergies, parasites, anxiety, and health issues
- [Why is My Dog Losing Hair?](https://www.evergreenvetclinic.com/blog/why-is-my-dog-losing-hair): Dog hair loss causes: allergies, fleas, Cushing's Disease, anxiety
